How it works

Three steps to paid

No training needed. Our invoice generator for small businesses and freelancers lets you create and send invoices online in three simple steps.

1

Create your invoice

Pick a template, add your client and items. Done in under a minute.

2

Send it instantly

Email your invoice directly or share a payment link your client can click.

3

Keep it organized

Track invoices, expenses, documents, partners, and items from the same menu.
